quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Victor White is named CMO on an official VivaVita exhibitor page and CMO, Apex Multiverses Expos & Summits on a brand-partnership page. He is relevant as a partnership/exhibitor-routing contact, but no source establishes Punta Cana hotel procurement or contract authority. A second fully named commercially relevant organizer/buyer was not verified. An Apex proposal quotes a founder identified only as “Marco”; that incomplete identity is not treated as a verified buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Organizer-published activity dates: February 18–21, 2027, Punta Cana, Dominican Republic, within the requested horizon. February 18 is the trade-only B2B Travel Market; February 19–21 are public/trade show days. The edition page and series city directory agree. This verifies the advertised schedule, not operational delivery; the edition page says general ticket sales have not started.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: prioritize guestroom-led exhibitor, organizer or hosted-buyer stays, with small briefings or networking functions, rather than assume the full expo fits. Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana publishes 620 rooms, all-inclusive services, Uvero Alto location, three modular meeting rooms totaling 380 m² and a 200–300-person event facility. The advertised ten-world, public-facing show needs a floor plan, booth count, public-access policy and simultaneous-space requirements before whole-event hosting can be assessed. No event-specific attendance or room demand is published.
findings.venueCommitments: The exact edition page explicitly states “Venue to be announced.” No named host hotel or lodging commitment was found. This is not evidence that hotel sourcing is open, nor that demand is committed elsewhere. Resorts mentioned as destination attractions on broader VivaVita pages must not be treated as contracted venues.
findings.historicalRotation: No completed Punta Cana edition or historical incumbent hotel was verified. The series directory advertises a multi-city circuit, including Cancún February 11–14, Punta Cana February 18–21 and San Juan February 25–28, 2027. These are separate city editions, not evidence of a single rotating annual conference or proof that past advertised editions occurred. No subsequent Punta Cana edition through May 2028 was verified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing is unconfirmed. No accommodation booking link, negotiated rate, room block, room-night requirement, lodging RFP, appointed housing agent or DMC was identified for the exact edition. The published route is info@gotoapex.com for exhibiting, sponsorship and group-ticket enquiries; ask that team to route a hotel-partnership enquiry to the lodging decision-maker. Hosted buyers are an advertised audience, not proof of organizer-funded accommodation.
findings.organizationStructure: VivaVita is an event brand/circuit within Apex Business Group Worldwide, not a verified independent professional association. Apex’s legal center identifies Apex Business Group Worldwide S.L., Spain, CIF B93697449, as commercial operator and distinguishes it from Alpha Academy, a public-benefit association. For directly organized Apex events, Apex describes itself as commercial organizer/coordinator engaging venues and logistics providers. The exact Punta Cana contracting entity, local co-organizer, PCO and DMC remain unverified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No incumbent competing hotel, sold-out condition, contracted room block or overflow requirement was verified. Do not import the broader VivaVita calendar’s 250–350 congress delegates or 1,500–3,000+ visitors into this travel-show edition; those are different programme-level claims. Inference: modest indoor exhibition space and the need to move guests between Uvero Alto and an unannounced venue constrain hotel capture. Do not treat a future Cap Cana venue as automatic demand for this property.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send one targeted enquiry to info@gotoapex.com, addressed to the Punta Cana event lead and requesting referral through Victor White. Confirm the February 18–21 edition is proceeding; request the contracted/planned venue, named lodging decision-maker and local delivery partner, whether hotel bids are being accepted, expected nonlocal overnight guests, paid versus hosted accommodation, arrival/departure pattern, peak rooms, budget and transfer needs. If an actual guestroom requirement exists, offer an all-inclusive accommodation-led option with appropriately sized briefings; do not quote a whole-expo package or hold inventory before requirements are supplied.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the February 2027 edition, public commercial enquiries are available, but hotel procurement access is unknown. Tickets are not yet on general sale on the exact edition page. This is an early qualification/relationship path, not a sales-ready room block or confirmed open sourcing opportunity; there is no sourced basis to label it closed or committed elsewhere.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: build an organizer relationship for any later Punta Cana hotel partnership after verifying delivery and demand. The global circuit supports a series relationship thesis, but does not establish annual Punta Cana recurrence, a 2028 date or a future bid window. No future competitive-capture cycle can yet be qualified.
